summary: The student interprets questions asking what a group of blocks is worth altogether as asking for the count of those blocks rather than their total value.
problem: What are those hundred-flats worth altogether? Mat value 2640; asked block size: hundred-flats.
subject: MATHEMATICS
teachingImplication: Contrast the quantity of blocks with their cumulative value by having the student multiply the count of blocks by the value of a single block.
checkNext: Present a set of tens-rods or hundred-flats and ask for their total worth to see if the student continues to report only the number of blocks present.
